Automatic Garmin updates

One-time connection required.

After setup, your runs update about every six hours. Sync your watch with Garmin Connect, then open this page on any device.

The owner connects Garmin once using the project’s setup tool. Your Garmin password is never entered on this public page.

Import a file instead

Import the activities CSV from Garmin Connect. Your runs replace the sample data on this browser.

  1. Open Garmin Connect activities ↗ on the web.
  2. Load your running history back to July 2026, then choose Export CSV.
  3. Choose your export below. Use an English-language CSV; set the units to match your export.

Files stay in this browser. To update your GitHub page, replace dist/data/activities.json with the downloaded website data and push. That file contains activity summaries you choose to publish; GPS routes and account credentials are excluded.

A browser import overrides the website’s shared data on this device. Clear it to return to automatic updates.
